name: plugin.open_source_gis
description: Open-source GIS analytical engine selector, CRS projection safety validator, topology hygiene auditor, and visual brief generator across 14 GIS engines

entrypoints.name: gis_route_workload
entrypoints.description: Route spatial analysis workloads to optimal open-source GIS engines (QGIS, SAGA, Whitebox, GRASS, GeoDa, gvSIG, MapWindow, Diva GIS, OrbisGIS) using deterministic fitness matching

parameters.name: has_lidar
parameters.description: Whether workload contains LiDAR point cloud datasets

parameters.name: needs_statistics
parameters.description: Whether spatial regression or spatial autocorrelation is needed

parameters.name: needs_mobile
parameters.description: Whether field mobile GPS capture is required

entrypoints.name: gis_validate_pipeline
entrypoints.description: Validate a spatial pipeline execution DAG for metric Coordinate Reference System (CRS) projection safety and format handoffs

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: List of pipeline step dictionaries with step_id, operation, engine, input_crs, output_crs, input_format, output_format

entrypoints.name: gis_audit_topology
entrypoints.description: Audit vector polygon geometries for topological integrity: self-intersections, unclosed rings, duplicate vertices, and micro-slivers

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: GeoJSON Feature array with geometry and properties

parameters.name: sliver_threshold_m2
parameters.description: Area threshold in square meters below which polygons are flagged as slivers

entrypoints.name: gis_architect_workload
entrypoints.description: End-to-end spatial workload architecture interrogation: routes engines, checks DAG CRS safety, audits geometry topology, and renders Stage 5 HTML visual brief

parameters.name: workload_profile
parameters.description: Workload profile dictionary defining domain, geometry_type, data_formats, sector, analysis

parameters.name: pipeline_steps
parameters.description: Optional pipeline execution steps to validate

parameters.name: generate_brief
parameters.description: Whether to render self-contained HTML visual brief to %TEMP%
